features.title: Daily Bread & Morning Reflection
features.summary: Fresh daily scripture verse, rich theological context, morning devotional reflection, 3 actionable 'Living It Out' application points, text-to-speech audio, WhatsApp sharing, and archive of recent reflections.

features.title: Comprehensive Bible Explorer
features.summary: Complete 66-book Old and New Testament reader with lightning-fast full-text search, book and chapter navigation, and adjustable reading text sizes.

features.title: Interactive Prayer Wall
features.summary: Community intercession wall where believers can submit prayer requests with category selection and confidentiality controls (public for community prayer or private for pastoral team).

features.title: Gospel Clarity & Christian Foundations
features.summary: Clear, scripture-anchored explorations of core Christian doctrines including salvation, grace, faith, repentance, Jesus Christ, and eternal life.

features.title: Searchable Theological Topics
features.summary: Explore foundational topics and questions regarding Christian theology with dedicated scripture references and insights.

features.title: User Profiles & Authentication
features.summary: Single-click Google OAuth sign-in and email subscription to save bookmarks and receive daily devotionals.
